seo.title: Privacy Policy - Noktah Inovasi Teknologi
seo.description: Privacy Policy for Noktah Inovasi Teknologi. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27 of 2022).
seo.keywords: privacy policy, personal data protection, UU PDP, Law 27 2022, personal data, noktah

hero.description: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data across all Noktah brands.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.appliesTo: This Privacy Policy applies to {company} and both of our brands, {eskala} and {venyu}. We are operated under {parent}, an Indonesian company based in Sleman, Yogyakarta.
intro.compliance: This policy complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27 of 2022) and explains how we collect, use, process, and protect your personal data when you use our services.
intro.ageRequirement: Age Requirement: Our services are only available to individuals aged 18 years and above.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.personalLead: We collect the following personal data when you use our services:
collect.identityBody: Full name, date of birth, identity document numbers
collect.contactBody: Email address, phone number, physical address
collect.digitalBody: Photos, videos, profile images, and other media content
collect.personalizedBody: Preferences, settings, usage patterns, and behavioral data
collect.technicalBody: IP address, device information, browser type, cookies
collect.eskalaBody: Healthcare facility details, campaign briefs, brand assets, content materials, and performance data for the ad accounts and social channels we manage on a client's behalf
collect.venyuBody: Venue and court details, schedules and booking history, member and subscription records, staff attendance, and payment records

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.lead: We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds under UU PDP 2022:
legalBasis.consentBody: Your explicit, informed, and specific consent for particular purposes
legalBasis.contractBody: Processing necessary to perform our services and contractual obligations
legalBasis.legalBody: Compliance with Indonesian legal and regulatory requirements
legalBasis.vitalBody: Protection of life, health, and safety of data subjects
legalBasis.publicBody: Tasks carried out in the public interest or official authority
legalBasis.legitimateBody: Our legitimate business interests that don't override your rights

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.lead: We use your personal data for the following purposes:

content.title: Content Ownership and Licensing
content.professionalLead: {highlight} (Eskala's creative services, including social media content, brand materials, and marketing assets) become our intellectual property upon completion and payment.
content.professionalHighlight: All creative content produced by our professional teams
content.professionalDetail: This includes but is not limited to: social media content, brand identity materials, marketing campaigns, photography, videography, graphic design, copywriting, and any commissioned creative works.
content.ugcLead: {highlight} (profile pictures, user photos, personal content) remains your property. However, by using our services, you grant us a license to:
content.ugc1: Display and store your content as part of our services
content.ugc2: Process and analyze content for service improvement
content.ugc3: Create backups and ensure service continuity
content.ugcWithdraw: You can withdraw this license by deleting your content or terminating your account.

sharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.lead: We may share your personal data in the following circumstances:
sharing.internalBody: Between Eskala and Venyu for integrated service delivery
sharing.vendorsBody: With trusted third-party vendors who assist in service delivery (payment processors, cloud storage, analytics)
sharing.legalBody: When required by Indonesian law, court orders, or government authorities
sharing.safetyBody: To protect our rights, safety, and security of users and prevent fraud or illegal activities

security.title: Data Security
security.lead: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
security.detail: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction, in accordance with industry standards and legal requirements.
security.commitmentBody: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your data. While we strive to maintain appropriate security standards, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.
security.breachBody: In the event of a data breach, we will comply with all notification requirements under UU PDP 2022 and applicable Indonesian law.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.lead: Under Indonesian Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP 2022), you have the following rights:
rights.accessBody: Request information about what personal data we hold about you
rights.rectificationBody: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data
rights.erasureBody: Request deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances
rights.withdrawBody: Withdraw your consent for data processing at any time
rights.objectBody: Object to processing of your personal data for specific purposes
rights.portabilityBody: Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format
rights.restrictBody: Request limitation of processing under certain circumstances
rights.informationBody: Be informed about how your data is being processed
rights.exerciseLead: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at {email}. We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by Indonesian law.
rights.exerciseNote: Please note that some rights may be limited by legal obligations or legitimate business interests.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.lead: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law.
retention.generalBody: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy or as required by Indonesian law.
retention.generalNote: Certain data may be retained for longer periods when required by Indonesian tax, accounting, or other legal obligations.
retention.professionalBody: All creative content produced by our professional teams (Eskala's creative services) may be retained as our intellectual property.

transfers.title: International Data Transfers
transfers.lead: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed outside Indonesia for cloud storage, payment processing, and other service delivery purposes.
transfers.detail: When we transfer your data internationally, we ensure adequate protection as required by UU PDP 2022 and obtain your consent where necessary.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.lead: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and improve our services.
cookies.essentialBody: Required for basic website functionality and security. These cannot be disabled.
cookies.nonEssentialBody: Used for analytics, personalization, and marketing. You can control these through your browser settings.
cookies.manage: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.lead: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, services, or legal requirements.
changes.notificationBody: We will notify you of significant changes via email or prominent notice on our website
changes.effectiveBody: Changes become effective as permitted by law, with advance notice where required
changes.continuedBody: Your continued use of our services after changes indicates acceptance of the updated policy

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.lead: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us:
contact.responseBody: We will respond to your privacy-related inquiries within the timeframe required by Indonesian law.
contact.authorityBody: You may also file personal data protection complaints with Indonesia's Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), which currently carries out the personal data protection supervisory function, or with the personal data protection supervisory authority established under UU PDP.

compliance.title: Legal Compliance
compliance.body: This Privacy Policy complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27 of 2022) and other applicable Indonesian regulations. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal data responsibly.
